name: Ellad B. Tadmor
research_summary: Tadmor develops physics-based and machine-learning models of how solid and two-dimensional materials respond to heat, forces, and failure. He connects atomic-scale behavior with larger-scale mechanics using molecular dynamics, finite-element methods, and multiscale modeling.
